What are the golf privileges and eligibility criteria? As an Emeralde Private Metal, Credit Cardholder, you are eligible for unlimited round or lesson of golf. The benefit can be booked through the Golftripz website. Simply visit https://teetimes.truztee.com/   and create a Golftripz account using the same e-mail ID as registered against your ICICI Bank Credit Card. Benefits will be credited to your account by the 10th day of the following month, available for use in the next two months. To view the updated list of golf courses, please click here . You may also call iAssist, the 24x7 concierge service on 1800-26-70731 (toll free for MTNL or BSNL lines) or 022-67872016 (standard call charges applicable) for assistance with online booking. Eligible ICICI Bank Credit Card members can book their Golf Rounds by following the below steps: Log in to the ICICI Bank Golf platform https://teetimes.truztee.com/ with your registered mobile number. Choose your preferred golf course and select your preferred date and tee time. Submit your booking request and await confirmation. Check your Booking History to view all bookings and details. You may also call i-Assist, our 24X7 concierge service on 1800 26 70731 (toll free for MTNL/BSNL lines) or 022 6787 2016 (standard call charges applicable), for assistance with online booking. Any additional bookings beyond the complimentary benefit will be charged as per the rates decided by the service provider. To book your movie ticket and for detailed terms & conditions, please click here . What are the key features of the concierge services offered? The concierge services provide 24/7 support for varied needs such as restaurant reservations, flower and gift deliveries, hotel and flight bookings, car rentals and even movie ticket delivery. Additionally, the service offers emergency auto assistance and medical concierge support, ensuring comprehensive assistance during emergencies. Contact i-Assist for access to these services. To contact the i-Assist team, please call 1800 26 70731 (toll free for MTNL/BSNL) or 022 6787 2016 (standard call charges applicable). What Air Accident Insurance coverage is provided to Cardholders? The primary Cardholder is entitled to Air Accident Insurance coverage of ₹3 crore. This benefit applies only when the Card has been used at least once in the 60 days prior to the event. Note that the insurance covers international travel only, provided that the tickets were purchased using the Credit Card. Supplementary Cardholders are not eligible for this insurance coverage. For more details on the terms and conditions of the insurance cover on ICICI Bank Credit Cards. What is the fuel surcharge waiver offered to Cardholders? Cardholders can avail of a 1% fuel surcharge waiver on all fuel transactions of up to ₹4,000 at any fuel outlet in India. This benefit applies to both the primary Cardholder and the Plus (supplementary) cardholder, helping them save on regular fuel expenses. The waiver is automatically applied when the eligible transaction is completed using the Credit Card. What fraud protection benefits are available to Cardholders? Cardholders are protected against fraudulent transactions with Counterfeit Card Liability, ensuring coverage against unauthorised usage. Additionally, the Card provides an Account Takeover Cover, which safeguards you in case your personal information is accessed or misused by a third party without your consent. What security features are provided by the chip and PIN? The Credit Card comes with an embedded microchip that provides enhanced security against counterfeiting and duplication. For transactions at merchant outlets, customers must enter a Personal Identification Number (PIN) to complete the payment. However, this PIN is not required for online transactions. To know more about Chip and PIN security, please click here . What is the age limit for the Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card? You must be between the age group of 21–65 years to be eligible to apply for the ICICI Bank Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card. How can I know the bill due date of my ICICI Bank Credit Card? You can find the bill due date of your Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card on your monthly statement, in the iMobile app, through Internet Banking or by contacting Customer Care at 1800 1080. Is it safe to transact with the Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card? Yes. Since your Emeralde Private Metal Credit Card comes with an embedded microchip for high-level security, you can transact safely & securely. What are the key features of the Mastercard Privileges? At the heart of this programme is a host of exceptional experiences designed to inspire and enrich the lives of our Mastercard cardholders, with programme members able to enjoy additional benefits. Are there any limits or exclusions? You can earn 2% ICICI Bank reward points on all eligible domestic transactions. However, there is a cap of 5,000 reward points per statement cycle for the following categories: Utility payments Insurance premium payments Education payments Government payments (such as property tax, advance tax, fees, court payments, postal payments, etc.) Additionally, ICICI Bank reward points will not be earned on fuel transactions, rent payments or transactions converted into EMIs. The points earned on such transactions will be reversed. What is the value of 1 ICICI Bank reward point, and how can it be redeemed? The value of 1 ICICI Bank reward point can be up to ₹ 1. However, when redeeming ICICI Bank reward points against your statement, the redemption rate is 1 Reward Point (RP) = ₹0.40. Does the Times Black Credit Card offer any luxury Gift Card benefits? Yes, as a Times Black Credit Card holder, you receive a TATA CLiQ Luxury Gift Card worth ₹10,000, which can be used to shop for premium luxury items and experiences. What are the Times Black Credit Card benefits related to international experiences? With the Times Black Credit Card, you can enjoy international experiences and benefits worth ₹10,000 on Klook, allowing you to explore exciting activities and attractions worldwide. What luxury stay benefits does the Times Black Credit Card provide? The Times Black Credit Card offers a one-night luxury stay at Ayatana or Lohono worth ₹20,000, providing an unforgettable getaway experience in a luxurious setting. You will receive an e-mail regarding the same within 45 business days after the payment of the joining fee. How do I complete my video KYC verification? You are required to provide your PAN Card and Aadhaar Card details followed by a video-based verification with an ICICI Bank employee. You will be required to accept a call request from the ICICI Bank employee and complete your video KYC by answering a few questions asked by them and showing the original PAN Card. Video KYC is available 24x7 on all days. How will I get the PIN for my Credit Card? You can generate the PIN in any of the following ways: Using the iMobile app: Go to Services > Card PIN Services > Generate Credit Card PIN Using Net Banking: Log into Net Banking > Generate Card PIN > Credit Card PIN > Select Card and enter CVV > Submit > Enter OTP > Enter PIN > Generate Now Using the Interactive Voice Response (IVR) system: Call Customer Care on 1800 1080 and follow the instructions. Central Travel Account Card FAQs
What is a Central Travel Account (CTA) Card?
The ICICI Bank CTA Card is a centralised corporate payment solution that allows businesses to manage all travel-related expenses through one account. Instead of issuing separate cards to each employee, the company can route bookings and payments centrally, ensuring better control, transparency, and simplified reconciliation.
Who can apply for a CTA Card?
The CTA Card is issued only to corporates and business entities that have regular travel and lodging requirements, subject to eligibility and documentation.
What are the key benefits of the CTA Card?
The card provides corporates with the convenience of making all payments through a single account, resulting in enhanced control over expenses. It helps in easier reconciliation through consolidated statements, supports integration with ERP systems and Travel Management Companies (TMCs). It is globally accepted at airlines, hotels and travel agencies, which makes it an ideal solution for managing both domestic and international travel expenses.
How is the CTA Card different from a Corporate Credit Card?
A Corporate Credit Card is issued to individual employees to meet their business travel and expense requirements, while a CTA Card is issued at the company level and is primarily used for centralised travel bookings. The CTA Card ensures that all travel spends are consolidated into one account, whereas Corporate Credit Cards are designed for distributed employee-level usage.
What kind of expenses can be paid using the CTA Card?
The CTA Card is designed exclusively for travel-related expenses. It can be used for airline tickets, hotel stays, payments to travel agencies and other lodging or transportation services, depending on the company’s agreement with the bank.
How does billing and repayment work?
All expenses incurred on the CTA Card are consolidated into a single monthly statement that the corporate is required to clear. This significantly reduces administrative work, and ICICI Bank also provides Enhanced Data through the Network that can be used for expense tracking and automated reconciliation across departments or projects.
What is the liability model for the CTA Card?
The liability for repayment lies entirely with the corporate entity. ICICI Bank enters into an agreement with the company that clearly defines repayment responsibilities and credit limits.
How can employee-wise or trip-wise spends be tracked?
ICICI Bank provides Enhanced Data by matching booking details from TMC and spend details of the card that allows corporates to tag expenses by employee ID, cost centre, project code or trip reference at the time of booking. This makes monitoring and allocation of costs simple and transparent.
Can international travel expenses be paid with the CTA Card?
Yes. The CTA Card can be used both for domestic and international travel. International usage will be subject to standard foreign exchange mark-ups and charges as per ICICI Bank’s policy, while ensuring seamless acceptance worldwide.
How can a company apply for the CTA Card?
A company can apply for the CTA Card by contacting its ICICI Bank Relationship Manager or visiting nearest branch. The process involves submitting required documents, undergoing a credit assessment and signing a corporate liability agreement.

As a Non-resident Indian (NRI), you can avail a credit card issued in India. This article explores the benefits of credit cards for NRIs and the application process for availing one.
What is an NRI credit card?
An NRI Credit Card is a credit card issued to non-residents by an Indian bank for international and domestic (India) usage. Just like credit cards issued to resident Indians it can be used for transacting in both online and offline modes.
Why do NRIs need a credit card?
As an NRI, you might travel frequently between India and other countries. A credit card can be very useful to manage planned and unexpected expenses and provides you with convenient credit access for both, domestic (India) and international transactions.
Many NRIs who visit India often incur significant foreign transaction fees when using their foreign bank credit and debit cards. An Indian credit card can help you avoid these charges.
Types of credit cards for NRIs
Indian banks offer a range of credit cards (Non-Resident External (NRE) / Non-Resident Ordinary (NRO) bank account-based credit cards) tailored to the needs of NRIs. By understanding the different types of credit cards, NRIs can choose the best available option as per their needs to manage their finances efficiently and avail additional benefits.
Did you know?
NRI credit cards are also issued against NRE/NRO fixed deposits held by NRIs.

Benefits of credit cards for NRIs
Like credit cards issued to resident Indians, NRI credit cards offer a host of advantages. They provide a credit facility, allowing you to access funds up to a specified limit with a pre-defined repayment term.
Did you know?
Leading banks in India allow NRIs to have their family members as supplementary cardholders.
By using the credit cards NRIs can avail the benefits listed below:
NRIs can make hassle-free online payments with options to pay in both Indian and international currencies. Please note, that international transactions may incur foreign exchange conversion charges
You can access international ATMs to withdraw cash in the local currency. Please note, that you may incur withdrawal fee and foreign exchange conversion charges
For domestic (India) transactions made on NRI credit cards, you can accumulate rewards and cashback
NRIs can also avail access to exclusive airline partnerships, offering benefits like lounge access, priority check-in, and bonus miles
Please note that the above benefits vary from bank to bank. Please get in touch with your bank for more details.
Applying for credit card for NRIs
To avail a credit card as an NRI, you should have:
A valid NRE or NRO bank account with the issuing bank
Adequate funds in the account, especially for secured credit cards
As part of the account opening process, you will have to submit the following documents including:
Copy of valid passport
Valid work permit/employment visa/admission letter etc
Indian address proof: Passport/Utility bill/Bank statement etc
Foreign address proof: Utility bills (any one of the latest electricity, water, telephone bill)/Residence permit/Property tax etc
Permanent Account Number (PAN) card or in the absence of a PAN card,  Form 60  (if applicable)
Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA)  declaration as applicable for the United States (US) or  Common Reporting Standard (CRS)  for the United Kingdom (UK), Canada or any of the 100+ countries that have adopted CRS
Please note that NRI credit card eligibility and assessment criteria can differ from bank to bank, considering factors like income, employment and financial history.
You can apply for an NRI credit card by visiting your bank's designated branch in India or overseas to submit the application form with requisite documentation.
Please note that the documentation requirement and application process may vary from bank to bank. For more details, you should get in touch with your bank or relationship manager.

An NRI credit card is a convenient way to manage your expenses while traveling in India by giving you quick access to credit. You can get NRI credit cards as long as you have a NRE or NRO bank account.  You may add family members (NRIs and resident Indians) as supplementary cardholders. NRO credit cards can be used only for domestic transactions, while NRE credit cards can be used for international transactions as well. You should connect with your bank for more details.
